name: homeplate
description: Homeplate v1.0 — two-sided home-cooked-meal marketplace (MSCS 2101, Group 6). Modular Node.js/Express monolith per SRS v3.2 and ADR-001..011.

scripts.test:a11y: node -e "var c=require('fs').existsSync('client');console.error('UT-01 / NFR-07 accessibility audit is not runnable in this repository state, and this script fails on purpose so its presence is never read as coverage.');console.error(c?'client/ exists: wave 5 must pin @axe-core/playwright plus a browser package as devDependencies (never npx --yes, which resolves an unpinned ChromeDriver against whatever browser the developer has), add a spec under tests/mt-ut-quality/ that boots the Vite preview server and audits all seven NFR-07 interfaces (search/browse, listing detail, host profile, booking flow, signup/login, messaging, moderator queue) at wcag2a/wcag2aa with zero serious or critical violations plus the keyboard-traversal checks, then replace this script with it.':'client/ is absent: the responsive React web client ships in waves 5-6 (SRS 2.1.2), so there is no interface to audit and no pinned browser toolchain in devDependencies. See docs/_generated/build-plan.md unit U7-A11Y-UX.');console.error('The 5-participant moderated usability study (SRS 4.5) stays a human activity and must be recorded with participants, date and triage outcome before NFR-07 can be closed.');process.exit(1)"
scripts.scan:zap: npm run scan:zap:run; npm run scan:zap:report
scripts.scan:zap:run: mkdir -p docs/results && { chmod -R a+w docs/results 2>/dev/null || true; } && docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "$PWD/docs/results:/zap/wrk:rw" ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t "${ZAP_TARGET_URL:-https://host.docker.internal:3000}" -I -m ${ZAP_SPIDER_MINUTES:-3} -r zap-baseline.html -w zap-baseline.md -J zap-baseline.json -z "-config certificate.allowUnsafeSslRenegotiation=true"
scripts.scan:zap:report: node -e "var fs=require('fs');var p=process.env.ZAP_REPORT_JSON||'docs/results/zap-baseline.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('AB-06 / ST-04: no ZAP report at '+p+' — the baseline run did not complete. Is the dev server reachable at the scanned URL? See .github/SECURITY-SCANS.md.');process.exit(1);}var r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));var sites=Array.isArray(r.site)?r.site:(r.site?[r.site]:[]);var alerts=sites.reduce(function(a,s){return a.concat(Array.isArray(s.alerts)?s.alerts:[]);},[]);var names=['Informational','Low','Medium','High'];console.log('AB-06 / NFR-11 / ST-04 — OWASP ZAP baseline alert table ('+p+')');for(var i=3;i>=0;i--){console.log('  '+names[i]+': '+alerts.filter(function(a){return Number(a.riskcode)===i;}).length);}var high=alerts.filter(function(a){return Number(a.riskcode)>=3;});high.forEach(function(a){console.error('  HIGH  '+a.alert+' ['+a.riskdesc+'] x'+a.count+' — '+((a.instances||[]).map(function(i){return i.uri;}).slice(0,3).join(', ')));});console.log(high.length?'FAIL: AB-06 requires no high-risk alerts.':'PASS: no high-risk alerts. Commit the report under docs/results/ with the run date and commit SHA (wave-7 close-out).');process.exit(high.length?1:0)"
